name: assembled_base_identity_swap
mechanism: Swap the color correspondence of the labeled short and long source bases with their three rotated assembled counterparts. This targets a/b identity during rotation and invites 3(2b-a), choice C; it adds no equality marks or cut lines.
primary_math_proof: Write t for either equal leg. The 60-degree assembly makes the horizontal excess of the long base b over the short base a equal t, so t=b-a. Each side of the equilateral hole is a-t=2a-b. Its perimeter is 6a-3b, uniquely E. Frozen display a=4,b=5,t=1 gives hole side3 and confirms this. Colors do not rename a/b, impose equal lengths, or alter the black semantic hole fill.
